LESSON: WRITING 4.4.1 GUIDED COMPOSITION: FRIENDLY LETTER/SMS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Writing 4.4.1 Guided Composition: Friendly Letter/SMS
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 4.4.1 Guided Composition: Friendly Letter/SMS, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you pass information to others? 2. How do you pass information to your friends? 3. What kind of information do you give to your friends?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 4.4.1 Guided Composition: Friendly Letter/SMS together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: observing an articulating signs clearly as learner discusses with peers, through signing,

how to write an SMS using the correct format.

36

● Self-efficacy: Knowing and saying my need is nurtured as learner expresses themselves through writing letters and SMS

with confidence.

Values:
● Unity: cooperation is developed as the learner cooperates with peers as they discuss letter writing through SMS.

● Integrity: is developed as the learner displays honest as they use a mobile phone.

Link to other subjects

The learner is able to relate the skill of letter writing to Kiswahili.
